name: skill-heaven
description: Working prototype of Skill Heaven for Claude Code, actively tested for public use. One mechanic — /summon, one skill into context for one session, nothing installed — on one line: zero · low · med · high · xhigh · max · ultra, whose four surfaces are contiguous bands read from the current rung. /skill-zero is the floor, /skill-heaven converges, /skill-hell explores, and /skill-ultra is the crown rung whose controller picks direction and depth per gap. Nothing on the line refuses. No rung carries a count and no summon is capped — what each rung reaches for is being worked out in use while the benchmark is built. Interfaces may change. The zero-default launcher and standing-dose statusline live in the claude-zero package, run from a source checkout — not part of this marketplace install.

tree_url.title: Gaia Registry generic projection URL
tree_url.description: URL of the generic Gaia Skill Tree projection the summon MCP server reads. Defaults to the public gaiaskilltree.com projection; override only to point at a different Gaia Registry build.

tree_named_url.title: Gaia Registry named projection URL
tree_named_url.description: URL of the Named Skills Gaia projection the summon MCP server reads. Defaults to the public gaiaskilltree.com projection; override only to point at a different Gaia Registry build.

zero_cuts.title: What Skill Zero cuts by default
zero_cuts.description: "automatic" (default) cuts only automatic summoning — manual /summon still works, per N13's product floor. "all" cuts manual /summon too. Claude Code's userConfig schema has no enum type; any value other than "all" is treated as "automatic" by plugins/skill-heaven/scripts/render-ladder.mjs's zeroCuts().
